name: LivingTrust
source: CRON 20261014: LivingTrust Mortgage Bank Plc statement of comprehensive income for the half year ended 30 June 2026, unaudited (NGX doclib filing library), whole naira as printed. Gross earnings less interest and similar expense equals the printed total operating income exactly, and that less the printed total operating expenses and the printed impairment charge equals the printed profit before tax; the printed profit before tax less the printed income tax expense equals the printed profit after tax. EPS in naira per share from the printed kobo figure. | LivingTrust Mortgage Bank Plc Annual Report, Financial Highlights p.10 (N thousands): gross earnings 3,758,160 and 2,891,657, profit before taxation 981,200 and 665,660, taxation 192,059 and 97,386, profit after taxation 789,141 and 568,274, EPS 15.78 and 11.37 kobo for 2024 and 2023. Only the 2024 and 2023 columns were replaced; the stored 2023 net profit had been the 2024 figure | CRON 20260929_195546: FY2022 and FY2021 profit before tax, income tax and net profit, and FY2020 gross earnings, corrected from the printed five year financial summary whose columns are 2024 down to 2020. Profit before tax less tax equals profit after tax for all five years. FY2025 left untouched because the summary does not cover it. FY2025 figures retained as previously stored; the five year summary does not cover 2025. CRON 2026-10-06: EPS for FY2020 derived as Net Profit divided by shares outstanding (5000000000 shares per static_data/ngx_pdfs/LIVINGTRUST.pdf, page 10 ('Issued Share). The 5 already-stored EPS figure(s) in this file reproduce that identity within 3 percent, and none contradict it.
